source_evidence: Interval funds can have many of the same types of fees and expenses as other investment companies, such as sales loads, repurchase fees, and management fees.
answer: Interval funds may charge sales loads, repurchase fees, and management fees. Their fees and expenses are listed in the fund’s prospectus fee table. Some interval funds may have higher fees than other types of funds, including higher management fees or costs associated with investing in certain assets. A repurchase fee may also be deducted from proceeds; the source says this fee cannot exceed 2% of the proceeds. Review and compare a fund’s fees and expenses before investing.
